title: LXR mediated-signalling protects human hair follicles against doxorubicin-induced toxicity ex vivo
description: Although chemotherapy-induced alopecia (CIA) is one of the most distressing adverse effects of cancer treatment, there are still no pharmacological interventions available and there remains an urgent unmet need to identify novel targets for therapy. We hypothesized that selected compounds which enhance ABC transporter activity and thus drug efflux from CIA-affected hair follicle (HF) epithelium may award relative protection from chemotherapy-induced HF toxicity. We found that the LXR agonist T0901317 significantly increased cell survival, attenuated LDH release, caspase-3 activity and DNA double strand breaks (DSBs) in doxorubicin (DOX)-treated outer root sheath keratinocytes (ORS-KCs) in vitro and protected human HFs from DOX-induced apoptosis ex vivo. RNA sequencing was performed to investigate the potential mechanism(s) by which T0901317 may protect against DOX-induced cell survival and apoptosis of ORS-KC.

samples.title: Sample 3
samples.description: Protocols: Outer root sheath keratinocyte (ORS-KCs) were isolated from plucked hair follicles (HFs) using enzymatic digestion as previously described (PMID: 21593771) with minor alterations. Briefly human HFs were plucked from the temporal scalp, washed in PBS with Gentamycin and incubated for up to 45 min with 0.25% Trypsin EDTA. Following removal of the ORS, cells were seeded onto a feeder layer of human dermal fibroblasts pre-treated with 4µg/ml Mitomycin C (Sigma) and grown in ORS media comprising of a 3:1 mix of DMEM Glutamax (Gibco) and Ham’s F-12 Nutrient mix (Gibco) supplemented with 10% foetal calf serum (Gibco), 5µg/ml insulin, 0.4µg/ml hydrocortisone, 2.4 µg/ml adenine, 2nM T3, 0.1nM cholera toxin, 10ng/ml EGF, 1mM ascorbyl-2-phosphate, Penicillin and 25µg/ml gentamycin. Approximately 1-2 weeks later when cells had established colonies, they were removed from feeder layers and subsequently cultured in epilife media (Gibco) and used between passages 2-5. This study of outer root sheath keratinocyte (ORS-KCs) had 4 conditions with n=3. Conditions: Control, T0901317, doxorubicin (DOX), T0901317+DOX. ORS-KCs were isolated from plucked hair follicles (HFs) using enzymatic digestion as previously described (PMID: 21593771) with minor alterations. Briefly human HFs were plucked from the temporal scalp, washed in PBS with Gentamycin and incubated for up to 45 min with 0.25% Trypsin EDTA. Following removal of the ORS, cells were seeded onto a feeder layer of human dermal fibroblasts pre-treated with 4µg/ml Mitomycin C (Sigma) and grown in ORS media comprising of a 3:1 mix of DMEM Glutamax (Gibco) and Ham’s F-12 Nutrient mix (Gibco) supplemented with 10% foetal calf serum (Gibco), 5µg/ml insulin, 0.4µg/ml hydrocortisone, 2.4 µg/ml adenine, 2nM T3, 0.1nM cholera toxin, 10ng/ml EGF, 1mM ascorbyl-2-phosphate, Penicillin and 25µg/ml gentamycin. Approximately 1-2 weeks later when cells had established colonies, they were removed from feeder layers and subsequently cultured in epilife media (Gibco) and used between passages 2-5. ORS-KCs were cultured for 72 hours in the presence or absence of 5 µM T0901317 before the addition of 5 µM DOX for 4 hours to detect early changes in response to DOX. Following removal of the ORS, cells were seeded onto a feeder layer of human dermal fibroblasts pre-treated with 4µg/ml Mitomycin C (Sigma) and grown in ORS media comprising of a 3:1 mix of DMEM Glutamax (Gibco) and Ham’s F-12 Nutrient mix (Gibco) supplemented with 10% foetal calf serum (Gibco), 5µg/ml insulin, 0.4µg/ml hydrocortisone, 2.4 µg/ml adenine, 2nM T3, 0.1nM cholera toxin, 10ng/ml EGF, 1mM ascorbyl-2-phosphate, Penicillin and 25µg/ml gentamycin. Approximately 1-2 weeks later when cells had established colonies, they were removed from feeder layers and subsequently cultured in epilife media (Gibco) and used between passages 2-5. This study of outer root sheath keratinocyte (ORS-KCs) had 4 conditions with n=3. Conditions: Control, T0901317, doxorubicin (DOX), T0901317+DOX. ORS-KCs were isolated from plucked hair follicles (HFs) using enzymatic digestion as previously described (PMID: 21593771) with minor alterations. Briefly human HFs were plucked from the temporal scalp, washed in PBS with Gentamycin and incubated for up to 45 min with 0.25% Trypsin EDTA. Following removal of the ORS, cells were seeded onto a feeder layer of human dermal fibroblasts pre-treated with 4µg/ml Mitomycin C (Sigma) and grown in ORS media comprising of a 3:1 mix of DMEM Glutamax (Gibco) and Ham’s F-12 Nutrient mix (Gibco) supplemented with 10% foetal calf serum (Gibco), 5µg/ml insulin, 0.4µg/ml hydrocortisone, 2.4 µg/ml adenine, 2nM T3, 0.1nM cholera toxin, 10ng/ml EGF, 1mM ascorbyl-2-phosphate, Penicillin and 25µg/ml gentamycin. Approximately 1-2 weeks later when cells had established colonies, they were removed from feeder layers and subsequently cultured in epilife media (Gibco) and used between passages 2-5. ORS-KCs were cultured for 72 hours in the presence or absence of 5 µM T0901317 before the addition of 5 µM DOX for 4 hours to detect early changes in response to DOX. Total RNA was extracted using RNeasy® Microkit (Qiagen, UK) according to manufacturer’s protocol. Truseq stranded mRNA Assay. Paired end.
